node.title: FPC5 M=4,t=2 official locator slices have positive codimension
node.statement: On the official rows k=2^40, every M=4,t=2 full-petal cell d=ell+s has positive locator-slice codimension c=ell-s-1. At rate 1/2, the threshold gives s<=b; writing j=ell-b, the source equation gives 5ell=k+1+j and k=1 mod 5, hence j=3 mod 5 and c>=j-1>=2. At rate 1/4, the exact defect cap gives c>=2ell-k; with 5ell=3k+1+j and j>=1, this is at least (k+4)/5. Thus the codimension-zero endpoint s=ell-1 is impossible at both surviving rates.
